description:
Image Edit tools for the Draftless AI creative studio. Requires sign-in to run. Actions:
- upscale_image: Upscale an image to higher resolution.
- remove_background: Remove the background from an image and return a transparent PNG.
- outpaint_image: Expand an image's canvas by a percentage on each side, filling the new area with AI-generated content.
- reframe_image: Reframe an image to a new aspect ratio by outpainting new content on the sides (never cropping).
- apply_relight: Relight an existing image: light direction, intensity, warmth and ambient fill, keeping subject and composition.
- edit_image_inpaint: Edit an image inside a masked region: replace, remove, or restyle pixels covered by the mask while keeping the rest untouched.
- composite_image: Add an image overlay (logo / badge / watermark), a text caption/label (true-type Inter, not bitmap), and/or a designed 'Powered by <Brand>' 
- add_badge: The result is saved to your asset library and returned as a durable URL.

input.description: Arguments for the action (see discover.describe_action once signed in).
